features.description: Suggest note updates is on by default; the account switch preserves the existing sourceBehaviors preference.

Renaming, archiving and contact-list edits update the canonical People note and its contact projection together. Empty contact lists can be cleared; summary fields stay unchanged on note-backed edits.
The packaged indexing worker can check for an optional source provider. When no provider is present it finishes without changing People data. Live provider delivery remains unverified.

Manual indexing accepts up to fifty source references and queues each for fifteen minutes later. Repeated requests retain the legacy standard-queue behavior. Invalid batches are rejected before any job is sent. A failure or timeout can leave earlier jobs queued and an unsent command stored. Repeating a request creates separate jobs and more stored commands; check earlier work before retrying. Command cleanup, limits, the installed screen and live source delivery remain unverified.

Browse directories relative to the selected People folder through the legacy API, in the same reading order as the legacy app (base letter first, then accent, then case). The Settings chooser still uses allowed absolute notes roots.

Canonical-note edits keep the legacy handling of aliases, emails and phones, including nulls, empty lists and mixed JSON list values. Numeric contact values keep the legacy decimal spelling, including equal-distance rounding ties. Unusable list values return an error; legacy empty list items may publish unreadable frontmatter before projection fails. Repair the note and retry. Missing notes retain projection-only fallback. Dollar replacement tokens remain literal to protect human text.
